availability: Vendor receipt is retained separately from SEC filing/acceptance and current source capture. No automatic available_at or vendor-vintage certification.
matching: Unique dated fund/portfolio intervals. SEC CUSIP9 or embedded US-ISIN CUSIP8 matched to CRSP CUSIP8 at the same report date. No ticker-only match or inferred non-US identifier bridge.
purpose: Diagnostic coverage and one snapshot reconciliation; not a strategy test or source-admission threshold.
values: Compare unscaled shares and USD market values exactly; retain all residuals. Rank ties are not assumed duplicate records. Do not normalize weights.
